paper_title: Extending Fairness Expressibility of ECTL+: A Tree-Style One-Pass Tableau Approach
classifications: Theory of computation → Modal and temporal logics
statement: Our tableau technique is not directly extensible to CTL? . Without any significant modifications, β + -rules become unsound for inputs that are beyond ECTL# syntax due to nested path subformulae as in A♦(◦p ∧ E◦¬p). To show the correctness of β + -rules, we developed the technique to identify relevant state-formulae inside the specific path-modalities. This technique will be useful in studying more expressive logics (e.g. CTL? ), as it allows to identify those subformulae that do not affect the “context”, thus enabling the simplification of the structures. O(m2 ) The size of the systematic tableau for the input of size m is bounded by 22 (see technical report http://www.sc.ehu.es/jiwlucap/TechReport18.pdf). However, the method aims at the “shortest” way to fulfil the eventualities and, for many examples, finds the first open bunch, giving us a model for the tableau input. This significantly reduces the complexity. Finally, the presented technique is amenable for implementation – and this will be another stream of our future work. In the refinement and implementation of the algorithm we will be able to rely on similar techniques used in the implementation of its linear-time analogue.
